WITH per_event AS (
    SELECT
        link_to_event,
        AVG(spent) AS avg_spent,
        AVG(remaining) AS avg_remaining
    FROM budget
    GROUP BY link_to_event
),
with_difference AS (
    SELECT
        link_to_event,
        avg_spent,
        avg_remaining,
        avg_remaining - AVG(avg_remaining) OVER () AS difference
    FROM per_event
)
SELECT link_to_event, avg_spent, avg_remaining, difference
FROM with_difference
ORDER BY difference DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10;
